checks.explanation: Mixed outcome. Trudeau did resign under pressure in March 2025, matching that part of the prediction, and AfD did surge dramatically in Germany's February 2025 election, doubling its vote share to 20.8% (a historic result), though it placed second, not first as 'will win' implied. However, the broader thesis of a clean 'repudiation of progressivism' doesn't hold cleanly: Canada's Liberals, under new leader Mark Carney, actually won the April 2025 election (Conservative leader Poilievre even lost his own seat), the opposite of a conservative sweep.

sources.title: Justin Trudeau: Canadian Prime Minister has announced his resignation

checks.explanation: Stablecoin usage exploded in 2025 largely as predicted: annual transaction volume hit $33 trillion, decisively surpassing Visa's network volume as forecast, and the GENIUS Act (signed July 2025) created the first federal regulatory framework, accelerating mainstream adoption. Market capitalization itself grew about 49% rather than the predicted 4-5x, but the core 'attack the Visa/Mastercard duopoly' thesis played out clearly.
